caption: The drawing features a group of four wooden soldier-like figurines, painted with grayish-white lower bodies, red torsos, and caps in varying shades of gray and red. Each figure is connected by thin rods to a cross-shaped wooden base at the bottom. At the center of this cross structure is a vertical pole with a turned, symmetrical design supporting the entire arrangement. On top of this central pole is a carved and painted bird, depicted with a run of gray and brown along its top and white underneath, facing to the right. The overall composition centers the bird above the soldiers evenly spaced around the central axis. The background is a plain, light beige with no additional elements or scenery.
title: Weather Vane
